rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt: Edit the supplied Danghu illustration to correct ONLY the pheasant anatomy. Keep its square cinematic painterly composition, close low camera, mountain sunset, long flowing throat-beard as the sole flight mechanism, warm dark colors, two feet, one body, long barred pheasant tail, and all feather textures. Replace the eagle head and hooked raptor beak with the clearly SMALL rounded head of a pheasant and a SHORT stout gamebird bill, tapered gently and completely WITHOUT a hooked raptor tip; retain two natural eyes, a small modest gamebird face, no eagle brow or hooked upper mandible. Make the two normal feathered wings visibly FOLDED FLAT along the left and right sides of the pheasant body; only the huge fibrous throat-beard spreads outward to provide lift. The beard must visibly grow from beneath the throat, not from the wings. Source anatomy wd-q17065939-c01/c06, beard flight c03/c06/c07, Mount Shangshen c02. Preserve one head, two eyes, two wings, two feet, one long barred tail. No new magic, no aura, no extra anatomy, no lettering, signature, pseudo-writing, border, watermark, nudity or gore. Original mythological creature, no film/game/anime design.
depicted_variant: A pheasant-shaped Danghu with small gamebird head and short bill, folded wings, and a huge throat-beard carrying it through the sky.

visual_requirements.description: Pheasant-shaped bird, small rounded gamebird head, short stout gently tapered bill with no hooked raptor tip, long barred tail, two folded wings and two feet.
Long throat-beard fans into the airflow and alone bears the bird in flight; both ordinary feathered wings remain folded.

aura: Impossible beard-borne flight c03/c06/c07, close framing and Mount Shangshen c02; no invented elemental effect.
artistic_choices: The pheasant bill and compact head correct the prior raptor interpretation; precise colors, sunset, mountain arrangement and camera are editorial. Wings remain folded to demonstrate the documented throat-beard propulsion, not normal wing flight. Natural bird scale and respectful awe; no invented aggression or magic.

rejected_attempts.reason: The beard flight works, but the head is a bird of prey: a hooked raptor beak and eagle face make it read as an eagle, not the pheasant-shaped bird of the sources [wd-q17065939-c01, c06]. Keep the composition and the spreading throat-beard [c03, c06, c07]; give it a pheasant's small head and short, stout gamebird bill, pheasant body proportions and the barred long tail, with the paired wings visibly folded so the beard alone carries it.
